title: evil lair [LORA/Krea 2]
description:
ENGLISH

I designed 3v1l l41r as a background LoRA concept for a generic 1960s-70s retro spy-fi supervillain base hidden inside a volcanic island. I wanted the playful extravagance of Space Age sets rendered as serious cinematic photographs: gold, lava orange, rounded lacquered surfaces and crimson or prune velvet.

I built the dataset around eleven distinct locations: a throne room with a lava window, a curved control center, a pastel brainwashing laboratory with an empty chair and suspended helmet, empty detention cells, an interrogation room, a red-laser trap corridor, a cover casino, a submarine dock, a lava reactor, private Art Deco apartments and a henchmen's mess. A final aerial view reveals the whole island at dusk.

I created g04ld pyr4m1d as a background concept for a colossal golden pyramid that is also an alien spacecraft. I wanted theatrical opulence, monumental scale and quiet menace: gold and sandstone, obsidian reflections, luminous crystals and green flames, with a different floor, lighting character and camera composition for each room.

A final dusk exterior reveals the complete pyramid on a desert plateau beneath an alien ringed sky.

v1 reproduces the intended art style more faithfully, with a stronger stylistic effect. However, generating at higher resolutions can occasionally cause visual distortions and anatomical errors, such as extra hands.

v2 shows little sign of overfitting, but its stylistic effect is noticeably weaker than v1.

Both versions have their own strengths, so choose whichever best suits your personal taste.

v1版本画风还原能力更强，但高分辨率有几率出现崩坏，多手的问题
